verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a board/item model with column values (`change_column_value`), custom board views and dashboards, and scheduled status updates and progress-gap tracking. Together these imply initiatives can be tracked as items with a status. However, nothing in the pack explicitly documents priority fields, assigning an owning team to an item, or an initiative/portfolio-level construct. Missing for 10: explicit priority field evidence, owning-team assignment, initiative-level tracking docs, independent hands-on corroboration.
